steps.command:
set -e
mkdir -p /app/ssl
chmod 700 /app/ssl
openssl version
python3 --version

set -e
ls -ld /app /workspace 2>&1 || true

mkdir -p /app/ssl
chmod 700 /app/ssl

# 1. 2048-bit RSA private key
openssl genrsa -out /app/ssl/server.key 2048
chmod 600 /app/ssl/server.key

# 2. Self-signed certificate, 365 days
openssl req -new -x509 -key /app/ssl/server.key -out /app/ssl/server.crt -days 365 \
  -subj "/O=DevOps Team/CN=dev-internal.company.local" \
  -sha256

chmod 644 /app/ssl/server.crt

# 3. Combined PEM (key + cert)
cat /app/ssl/server.key /app/ssl/server.crt > /app/ssl/server.pem
chmod 600 /app/ssl/server.pem

# 4. Verification details
{
  echo "Subject: $(openssl x509 -in /app/ssl/server.crt -noout -subject | sed 's/^subject=//')"
  echo "Not Before: $(openssl x509 -in /app/ssl/server.crt -noout -startdate | sed 's/^notBefore=//')"
  echo "Not After: $(openssl x509 -in /app/ssl/server.crt -noout -enddate | sed 's/^notAfter=//')"
  echo "SHA-256 Fingerprint: $(openssl x509 -in /app/ssl/server.crt -noout -fingerprint -sha256 | sed 's/^[^=]*=//')"
} > /app/ssl/verification.txt
chmod 644 /app/ssl/verification.txt

echo "--- verification.txt ---"
cat /app/ssl/verification.txt
echo "--- files ---"
ls -l /app/ssl

set -e
echo "== Permissions =="
ls -ld /app/ssl; ls -l /app/ssl /app/check_cert.py

echo; echo "== Certificate =="
openssl x509 -in /app/ssl/server.crt -noout -subject -issuer -dates -fingerprint -sha256

echo; echo "== Key strength / match =="
openssl rsa -in /app/ssl/server.key -noout -text | head -1
diff <(openssl x509 -in /app/ssl/server.crt -noout -pubkey) \
     <(openssl rsa -in /app/ssl/server.key -pubout) && echo "key matches certificate"

echo; echo "== Self-signed chain verify =="
openssl verify -CAfile /app/ssl/server.crt /app/ssl/server.crt

echo; echo "== Combined PEM =="
grep -c "BEGIN" /app/ssl/server.pem
openssl x509 -in /app/ssl/server.pem -noout -subject
openssl rsa -in /app/ssl/server.pem -check -noout && echo "PEM key valid"

echo; echo "== verification.txt =="
cat /app/ssl/verification.txt

echo; echo "== Python check =="
cd /app && python3 check_cert.py

a=$(openssl x509 -in /app/ssl/server.crt -noout -pubkey | openssl sha256)
b=$(openssl rsa -in /app/ssl/server.key -pubout 2>/dev/null | openssl sha256)
echo "cert pubkey: $a"
echo "key  pubkey: $b"
[ "$a" = "$b" ] && echo "OK: key matches certificate"
stat -c '%a %n' /app/ssl/server.key /app/ssl/server.crt /app/ssl/server.pem /app/ssl/verification.txt /app/check_cert.py
